prompt: Redesign as a low one-storey crop and flower seed shop: broad plaster facade, wide shaded veranda on pale wooden posts, red terracotta roof and small timber plant trellis. Open sales counter with seed sacks, flower trays and carrot pictogram. Warm limewashed plaster and light wood, not a tall medieval house. Keep source elevated orthogonal RPG camera, native pixels and thin outlines. Whole building in canvas, transparent background. No text, letters or people.

Convert this greenhouse into a semi-open tree nursery shop: weathered timber posts, low brick plinth, clay-tile roof over the rear bay and bamboo slatted canopy over the front. Remove most glass. Display three potted young fruit trees and tied seed sacks beneath the canopy, with tree pictogram. Visible roof and floor from above, source RPG camera and pixel density. Rustic airy structure, opaque materials, transparent background. No text or people.

Redesign as a squat farm-tool workshop with broad open double-door work bay. Dark rough timber walls, exposed red-brick furnace side, chunky grey stone footing, subdued slate-blue pitched roof and iron hinges. Show hoe, rake, shovel, watering can and workbench, not swords or armour. Remove decorative flowers. Keep elevated source RPG camera, clean pixel clusters and thin outlines. Strong low workshop silhouette. Transparent background. No text, lettering or people.

Make a broad low produce warehouse with horizontal weathered timber planks, red-clay gable roof and raised grey stone loading platform. Add two produce baskets and carrot pictogram. Clear warehouse silhouette, source elevated RPG camera, native pixels and dark contours. Transparent background. No animals, text or people.

Contrast smooth plaster, brick joints and brown timber. Preserve elevated RPG camera and pixel density. Transparent background. No text or people.

Redesign as a low rural restaurant with open kitchen wing: cream plaster, terracotta gable roofs, brown timber veranda and brick cooking hearth. Remove upper-floor dormer and ornate stone facade. Right wing becomes serving hatch with copper pots, bowls, stove and cream awning; left porch has one small table and stools. Bowl-and-spoon pictogram only.
